title: Implement the matching engine
description:
Implement deterministic token matching over extracted human text: word-boundary matching against case-folded text; unicode normalization (curly quotes and dashes to ASCII) before matching; a path/URL guard so a token immediately followed by a path separator or file extension does not count (for example a token appearing in a filename).

Done when: unit tests cover word boundaries (embedded occurrences do not match), case-insensitivity, normalization variants, and the path guard; matching is a pure function.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented src/sentiment/counting.ts matching engine: case-folded word-boundary regex, unicode normalization (curly quotes/dashes to ASCII before matching), and a path/URL guard (hasPathLikeSuffix rejects token followed by '/' or a file extension so 'thanks.md' never counts). Tests cover boundaries, caps, normalization, and path cases. Outcome: green.
